newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin falls four cents to 14.85 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin falls four cents to 14.85 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended four cents lower at 14.85 ringgit ($5.88) a kg in tandem with a lower overnight close on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"The local market was just following the LME," said a dealer. "There were no other leads."

There were initial bids for 39 tonnes against offers for 110. Final turnover fell to 90 tonnes from 124 previously, and was absorbed by Japanese, European and local interests. There was a discount of $10 against the London price.
